This tree is a subset of the upstream skill: the live kit, the three bundled
machines (`v8-live`, `cessna-live`, `strandbeest-live`) and their shared
sources, plus `sims/build.mjs`. Film capture, procedural score, ffmpeg,
Playwright, and Python sound tooling are omitted on purpose.
